payload.title: kbs init creates an unwanted CONTRIBUTING_AGENT_TEMPLATE.md alongside CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md
payload.description:
Running kbs init in a project creates CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md as intended, but it also creates a CONTRIBUTING_AGENT_TEMPLATE.md file in the project. We don't want the template file in initialized projects.

Expected: kbs init creates only CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md.
Actual: kbs init creates both CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT_TEMPLATE.md.

Fix should keep Rust and Python in sync and add a spec scenario asserting the template file is not created.

Reported by Ryan, 2026-10-02.
